\"At a recent workshop on mixed-effects models, a prominent
psycholinguist \[G. T. M. Altmann\] memorably quipped that encouraging
psycholinguists to use linear mixed-effects models was like giving
shotguns to toddlers\".\
\
Barr *et al* (2013) \"Random effects structure for confirmatory
hypothesis testing: Keep it maximal\" Journal of Memory and Language 68,
255--278. <http://idiom.ucsd.edu/~rlevy/papers/barr-etal-2013-jml.pdf>
